import json,sys
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
settings=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);base=settings['url'];driver=None
flags={'crossTabExpired':False,'restoredDestination':False,'manualCheck':False}
try:
    options=Options();options.binary_location='/usr/bin/chromium'
    for value in ['--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage','--window-size=1440,1000','--disable-background-networking']:
        options.add_argument(value)
    driver=webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'),options=options)
    driver.set_page_load_timeout(10);driver.set_script_timeout(5);wait=WebDriverWait(driver,8,poll_frequency=.1)
    def login():
        wait.until(EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.NAME,'email'))).send_keys('session-owner@example.test')
        driver.find_element(By.NAME,'password').send_keys('correct session password')
        driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'form button[type=submit]').click()
    def issue_ready(d):
        return d.execute_script('return document.querySelector("main h1")?.textContent.includes("Session return issue")')
    driver.execute_cdp_cmd('Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument',{'source':"window.sessionEvents=[];document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b)window.sessionEvents.push({kind:'click',text:b.textContent});},true);const send=window.fetch;window.fetch=async(...args)=>{const r=await send(...args);window.sessionEvents.push({kind:'response',path:new URL(args[0],location.href).pathname,status:r.status});return r;};"})
    driver.get(base+'/#/issues/'+settings['issueId']);login();wait.until(issue_ready)
    first=driver.current_window_handle
    driver.switch_to.new_window('tab');driver.get(base+'/#/')
    wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH,'//aside//button[normalize-space()="Sign out"]'))).click()
    wait.until(EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.NAME,'email')))
    driver.switch_to.window(first)
    wait.until(EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.NAME,'email')))
    assert driver.execute_script('return location.hash')=='#/issues/'+settings['issueId']
    assert not driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'nav[aria-label="Main navigation"]')
    flags['crossTabExpired']=True
    login();wait.until(issue_ready)
    assert driver.execute_script('return location.hash')=='#/issues/'+settings['issueId']
    flags['restoredDestination']=True
    before=driver.execute_script('const f=document.querySelector("aside footer"),b=[...f.querySelectorAll("button")].find(e=>e.textContent==="Sign out");return {height:f.getBoundingClientRect().height,offset:b.getBoundingClientRect().y-f.getBoundingClientRect().y}')
    wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH,'//aside//button[normalize-space()="Check session"]'))).click()
    wait.until(lambda d:'Session checked' in d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'aside footer').text)
    after=driver.execute_script('const f=document.querySelector("aside footer"),b=[...f.querySelectorAll("button")].find(e=>e.textContent==="Sign out");return {height:f.getBoundingClientRect().height,offset:b.getBoundingClientRect().y-f.getBoundingClientRect().y}')
    assert before==after, 'Session status must preserve footer height and relative control geometry: '+json.dumps({'before':before,'after':after})
    assert issue_ready(driver);flags['manualCheck']=True;flags['footerGeometry']={'before':before,'after':after}
except Exception as error:
    state=driver.execute_script('return {hash:location.hash,heading:document.querySelector("main h1")?.textContent,hasNavigation:!!document.querySelector("aside nav"),footer:document.querySelector("aside footer")?.textContent,events:window.sessionEvents}') if driver else None
    print(json.dumps({'error':str(error),'state':state,'flags':flags}),file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    if driver:driver.quit()
print(json.dumps(flags))
